---
title: Rationale
---

The choice of predicting taxi-out time for this year's Data Challenge
is in line with past data challenges' goals of providing information to estimate
environmental or operational impact.
Taxi-out time is generally difficult to obtain and quite difficult to predict.

A model to infer taxi-out time can be used in post-ops analysis to characterize
constrained operations intervals and measure excess fuel burnt/CO2 production
compared to unconstrained status.

The reasons for variability of taxi-out time are various and interlinked.
Taxi-out time can depend on airline-specific constraints, airport procedures
and load, \acr{ATFM}-related reasons.
